about.en: SHDW is the utility token of GenesysGo's Shadow (shdwDrive) network on Solana, a decentralized storage and compute DePIN in which users pay SHDW for storage and node operators stake it. It is the SPL token SHDWyBxihqiCj6YekG2GUr7wqKLeLAMK1gHZck9pL6y. It is unrelated to the older Shadow Token of the Shadow Era card game and to Shadowswap's SHDW.
